headline: Second invitation unlocked!
story:
Just a few days after my first invitation to a movie screening, I got invited again! This time, for the premiere night of Laya at SM Megamall.

And this one feels extra special because I got to experience an actual premiere night, complete with a blue carpet!

I've always been just a regular moviegoer who loves watching films, appreciating the craft behind them, and writing about my experiences. I never really imagined that this hobby would eventually open doors to events like this.

What I also love about these screenings is being surrounded by people who share the same passion and respect for cinema. It's a different experience from my usual solo movie trips.

Huge thanks again to Lunchbox PH for inviting me! I genuinely appreciate the trust and opportunity to be part of another screening.

And of course, my invitation doesn't influence my opinion of the film. You can always expect my honest thoughts, whether I loved it or not. 😂
